stem.en: What did Kamola notice at the stall?

options.en: Some customers wanted only a little fruit, but it was sold by the kilo.
Many customers thought that the fruit at the stall was not fresh enough.
There were too few customers at the stall on Saturday mornings.
The paper bags that her uncle used were too expensive for him.

why.en: She saw that older customers wanted only a few pieces of fruit, while her uncle sold everything by the kilo.
why.uz: U keksa xaridorlar bir-ikki dona meva olmoqchi boʻlganini, togʻasi esa hammasini kilolab sotishini payqadi.
why.ru: Она заметила, что пожилые покупатели хотели взять всего несколько фруктов, а дядя продавал всё на килограммы.

stem.en: Why was Uncle Rustam unsure about the idea at first?

options.en: He believed customers wanted to choose their own fruit.
He thought the paper bags would cost him too much money.
He thought Kamola was too young to work at the stall.
He did not have enough fruit to fill thirty bags.

why.en: He said, 'People come to the market to choose their own fruit.'
why.uz: U: «Odamlar bozorga mevani oʻzi tanlash uchun keladi», degan.
why.ru: Он сказал: «Люди приходят на рынок, чтобы самим выбирать фрукты».

stem.en: What does the passage suggest about the uncle on Sunday?

options.en: He now believed in the idea, though he did not say so.
He now believed in the idea and told Kamola she was right.
He liked the idea but wanted to charge more for each bag.
He liked the idea and asked Kamola to run the stall alone.

why.en: On Sunday he bought a hundred paper bags and asked for a sign, so he believed in the idea, but he 'didn't say much'. He did not tell Kamola she was right, change the price or give her the stall.
why.uz: Yakshanba kuni u yuzta qogʻoz xalta sotib oldi va yozuv tayyorlashni soʻradi, demak gʻoyaga ishondi, lekin 'koʻp gapirmadi'. U Kamolaga haq ekanini aytmadi, narxni oshirmadi va rastani unga topshirmadi.
why.ru: В воскресенье он купил сто бумажных пакетов и попросил сделать вывеску, значит, поверил в идею, но «почти ничего не сказал». Он не говорил Камоле, что она права, не поднимал цену и не отдавал ей прилавок.

stem.en: What is the passage mainly about?

options.en: How Kamola saw what some customers needed and found a way to sell to them
How Kamola persuaded her uncle to sell his fruit more cheaply than other stalls
How Kamola learned that customers prefer to choose their own fruit
How Kamola started her own small fruit stall next to her uncle's

why.en: The story follows Kamola from noticing that some customers wanted only a little fruit to the bags that sold out. Choosing your own fruit was the uncle's worry, which the sales proved wrong; nothing is said about cheaper prices or a stall of her own.
why.uz: Hikoya Kamola baʼzi xaridorlar ozgina meva olishni xohlashini payqaganidan boshlab, xaltalar sotilib tugaguncha boʻlgan voqeani kuzatadi. Mevani oʻzi tanlash amakining xavotiri edi, savdo buni rad etdi; arzonroq narx yoki Kamolaning oʻz rastasi haqida hech narsa deyilmagan.
why.ru: Рассказ прослеживает путь Камолы: она замечает, что некоторым покупателям нужно совсем немного фруктов, и в итоге пакеты раскупают. Выбирать фрукты самим — это опасение дяди, которое продажи опровергли; о более низких ценах или собственном прилавке Камолы ничего не сказано.

why.ru: Каждый вечер в десять автор оставлял телефон на кухонном столе, подальше от спальни.

stem.en: What is the writer's opinion of phones?

options.en: They are useful in the day, but not in the hour before sleep.
They are fine for messages, but watching videos is a waste of time.
They make it hard to concentrate, so the writer now uses one less in the day.
They are fine before sleep if you only check your messages.

why.en: The writer says 'I'm not saying phones are bad' and still uses one 'a lot during the day', but keeps the hour before sleep 'for books, not screens'. 'Just checking messages' at night was the old excuse that ended in videos.
why.uz: Muallif telefonlarni yomon demayotganini aytadi va kunduzi undan hamon koʻp foydalanadi, lekin uxlashdan oldingi bir soatni ekranlarga emas, kitoblarga ajratadi. Kechasi 'faqat xabarlarni koʻrish' videolar bilan tugaydigan eski bahona edi.
why.ru: Автор пишет: «Я не говорю, что телефоны — это плохо», и днём по-прежнему часто им пользуется, но час перед сном отдаёт «книгам, а не экранам». «Только проверить сообщения» ночью — старая отговорка, которая заканчивалась видео.

stem.en: What is the main purpose of the letter?

options.en: To ask for the group to be divided, or for some money back
To ask the centre to give the group a different teacher
To say that he and his sister will leave unless they get all their money back
To ask for an extra Saturday lesson so that the course can finish sooner

why.en: Dilshod complains that the group is too big and asks for two smaller groups, perhaps with a Saturday lesson, or for 'part of our money back'. He praises the teacher, does not say they will leave and does not want the course to end sooner.
why.uz: Dilshod guruh juda kattaligidan shikoyat qiladi va uni ikkita kichik guruhga boʻlishni, balki shanba kuni dars qoʻshishni, yoki pulning bir qismini qaytarishni soʻraydi. U oʻqituvchini maqtaydi, kursni tashlab ketishlarini aytmaydi va kurs tezroq tugashini soʻramaydi.
why.ru: Дильшод жалуется, что группа слишком большая, и просит разделить её на две, возможно добавив занятие в субботу, или вернуть «часть денег». Учителя он хвалит, не пишет, что они уйдут, и не просит закончить курс раньше.
